# m3_config.toml reference

<!-- GENERATED by bin/gen_config_docs.py from the config registry. Do not edit. -->

The file is `m3_config.toml` in the config root (`--config <file>` > `M3_CONFIG_ROOT` > `M3_MEMORY_ROOT/config` (legacy) > `~/.m3/config`). It carries `schema_version = 1`.

Precedence for each setting: the environment, for the keys marked *env override* only; then this file; then, until release N+3, the setting's legacy environment names; then the default. `m3 config show --origin` prints where each value came from.

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `deadline_s` | number | `60.0` | `M3_CHATLOG_EMBED_DEADLINE_S`, `CHATLOG_EMBED_DEADLINE_S` | restart to apply; Seconds one sweeper run may take; 0 or less is unbounded. |
| `max_per_run` | integer | `10000` | `M3_CHATLOG_EMBED_MAX_PER_RUN`, `CHATLOG_EMBED_MAX_PER_RUN` | restart to apply; Rows one sweeper run embeds. |

## [secrets]

| Key | Type | Default | Environment names | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `file` | path | (none) | (none) | restart to apply; The user-only plaintext secrets file, for hosts where no keyring serves m3's headless jobs (CONFIG_DESIGN §10). Default: <config root>/m3_secrets.toml. |

## Secrets

Secrets are never read from this file. Each resolves from the environment, then the OS keyring, then the user-only secrets file (`[secrets].file`), then the encrypted vault, except a *bootstrap* secret, which never comes from the vault.

| Name | Environment names | Bootstrap | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENT_OS_MASTER_KEY` | `AGENT_OS_MASTER_KEY` | yes | Key that decrypts the vault. |
| `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` | no | Anthropic API key. |
| `GEMINI_API_KEY` | `GEMINI_API_KEY` | no | Gemini API key. |
| `LM_API_TOKEN` | `LM_API_TOKEN`, `LM_STUDIO_API_KEY` | no | Token for the local LLM endpoint. |
